parameters.query:
INSERT INTO tickets (message_id, from_email, subject, body, language, category, priority, sentiment,
  summary, confidence, queue, status, guardrail_triggered, guardrail_reasons, llm_model, llm_latency_ms,
  prompt_tokens, completion_tokens)
SELECT message_id, from_email, subject, body, language, category, priority, sentiment,
  summary, confidence, queue, status, guardrail_triggered, guardrail_reasons, llm_model, llm_latency_ms,
  prompt_tokens, completion_tokens
FROM jsonb_populate_record(NULL::tickets, $1::jsonb)
ON CONFLICT (message_id) DO UPDATE SET message_id = EXCLUDED.message_id
RETURNING id, category, priority, queue, guardrail_triggered, guardrail_reasons, summary;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ticket_id: $json.id, category: $json.category, priority: $json.priority, queue: $json.queue, guardrail_triggered: $json.guardrail_triggered, guardrail_reasons: $json.guardrail_reasons, summary: $json.summary }) }}

parameters.content:
## 1. projekt – Support e-mail → LLM → ticket
Webhook (teszt) vagy IMAP (éles) → normalizálás + prompt → LLM (strict JSON schema, 3x retry) → parse + guardrails → Postgres ticket → válasz.

Guardrail találat esetén a ticket a **manual_triage** sorba kerül. A 3. projektben ide jön a hibaág és az alert.
